title.zh: 将伊洛伊洛省卡巴图安市镇图伊-安描笼涯图伊-安小学更名为Colomer小学的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Tuy-An Elementary School in Barangay Tuy-An, Municipality of Cabatuan, Province of Iloilo, as the Colomer Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Tuy-An Elementary School in Barangay Tuy-An, Municipality of Cabatuan, Province of Iloilo, as the Colomer Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học Tuy-An tại Barangay Tuy-An, Đô thị Cabatuan, Tỉnh Iloilo thành Trường Tiểu học Colomer
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Tuy-An ในบารังไกย์ Tuy-An เทศบาล Cabatuan จังหวัด Iloilo เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Colomer
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar Tuy-An di Barangay Tuy-An, Kotamadya Cabatuan, Provinsi Iloilo menjadi Sekolah Dasar Colomer
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah Tuy-An di Barangay Tuy-An, Perbandaran Cabatuan, Wilayah Iloilo kepada Sekolah Rendah Colomer

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6699_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Tuy-an Elementary School in Barangay Tuy-an, Municipality of Cabatuan, Province of Iloilo, is hereby changed to Colomer Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
